notes:
Summary: RelayCare (omni-channel contact center SaaS for healthcare clients). Interested in AI agent-assist + automated ticket summarization. Main ask: survive 3x baseline traffic spikes (seasonal + incident bursts) with <200ms median latency for assist calls, graceful queue backpressure, and reliable tool-calling (CRM writes) without duplicates.

Call highlights: 02/12 sync w/ VP Product + Head of SRE. They run peak loads during open enrollment windows and often see 4–6x traffic for short windows (10–45 minutes). Concerned about KV cache warmup and latency tail during cold starts. Quote from VP Prod: "We need predictable degradation — cheaper model or degrade to summaries, but never drop writes to CRM."

Technical constraints: multi-tenant architecture; must keep PII out of hosted logs; need KMS-managed keying and audit trails. Prefer VPC Private deployment for production; dedicated pool for pilot possible. Data residency requirement: US only.

POC asks: 1) run synthetic spike tests (burst arrival, sustained surge, flood with retries) 2) validate prefix/KV cache hit recovery and cold-start latencies 3) verify deduped tool-calls under retry storms 4) observe cost per 1M tokens under burst vs steady.

Sales notes: good rapport w/ Carlos+Maya. Legal has initial NDA but wants retention clause in contract. Pricing sensitivity moderate — willing to pay for guaranteed capacity for critical windows.

Status: Prepared sample workload, ready to hand to infra for POC; awaiting legal retention language and infra kickoff scheduling.
